purpose: Paired evaluation of the frozen live DINOv2 checkpoint and the frozen experimental DINOv3 checkpoint. Evaluation only.
data_readiness_rule: NO_GO_FOR_AUTHENTICITY_CLAIMS when the common held-out validation cohort does not contain both inherited directory labels or contains only one brand directory. This is decided from membership, before scores exist.

dinov2_legacy.preprocessing_definition: PIL RGB, bicubic stretch to 504 square, ImageNet mean/std, via backend inference.triton_client.preprocess_chw(side=504).
dinov2_legacy.score_definition: sigmoid(raw_logit). This is the operational score. It is not a calibrated probability.
dinov2_legacy.ranking_direction: higher logit is the fake-positive direction
dinov2_legacy.decision_definition: sigmoid(logit) >= 0.50 yields FAKE with confidence sigmoid(logit); otherwise AUTHENTIC with confidence 1-sigmoid(logit). AUTHENTIC is then remapped to FAKE when that confidence is strictly below 0.88. REVIEW is not a DINOv2 outcome.
dinov2_legacy.training_membership: Entire product folders listed in the checkpoint split manifest train_product_folders. This training run included sneaker folders as well as watch folders. Those sneaker folders are outside the 30000-image watch corpus and are not scored.
dinov2_legacy.validation_membership: Entire product folders listed in val_product_folders. Inside the watch corpus the only validation folder is Label_0_Watches/A. Lange & Söhne.

dinov3_experimental.preprocessing_definition: resize_pad_square_eval_v1 at 512 via ml_rtx5080.reference_inference.preprocess_image. Not the DINOv2 square stretch.
dinov3_experimental.score_definition: sigmoid(raw_logit / 0.24038200410185356). Temperature was fit on this checkpoint's calibration membership. The value is not a probability on the same scale as the DINOv2 sigmoid and must not be compared as one.
dinov3_experimental.ranking_direction: higher logit is the fake-positive direction
dinov3_experimental.decision_definition: Quality review (minimum side strictly below 512, or population luminance std strictly below 0.1933616647502347) yields REVIEW before the threshold. Otherwise temperature-scaled sigmoid >= 0.50 yields FAKE and a lower value yields AUTHENTIC. OOD is unavailable and is not recorded as a false flag.

membership_note: The live DINOv2 checkpoint was trained with a product-folder split that includes sneaker folders. DINOv3 epoch_018 was trained on split_manifest_v2, a brand-stratified watch split shared with the v2 DINOv2 research runs, which are different checkpoints. The two frozen checkpoints do not have the same training, calibration, or validation membership.
stored_validation_description_check: The statement that every authentic-labeled validation image is Vacheron Constantin and every fake-labeled validation image is Richard Mille does not describe either stored manifest. split_manifest_v2 validation contains all five watch brands and both directory labels. The live DINOv2 watch validation folder is entirely authentic-labeled A. Lange & Söhne. The protocol uses the stored manifests and does not relabel that cohort.

primary_validation.rule: An image is in the primary paired cohort only when it is in the live DINOv2 validation folders, in the DINOv3 validation membership, in neither model's training or calibration membership, not in the locked final test, not an excluded OOD path, readable, and carrying an explicit directory label of 0 or 1.

diagnostic_sweep.includes: Every watch-corpus image except the locked final test and excluded OOD paths.
diagnostic_sweep.train_and_calibration: diagnostic only; excluded from primary metrics
diagnostic_sweep.model_own_validation_outside_the_interse: descriptive only, with an explicit leakage flag when the other model trained or calibrated on those images

metrics.confusion: Counts of inherited directory label by native decision. FAKE is the positive class. REVIEW is its own predicted state.
metrics.binary_metrics: Accuracy, precision, recall, F1, and balanced accuracy use only rows whose native decision is AUTHENTIC or FAKE. Denominator is that binary-decision count. REVIEW and failed inferences are not silently mapped to either class.
metrics.false_authentic_rate: fake-labeled images decided AUTHENTIC, divided by all successful fake-labeled images in the cohort, including those decided REVIEW.
metrics.false_fake_rate: authentic-labeled images decided FAKE, divided by all successful authentic-labeled images in the cohort, including those decided REVIEW.
metrics.ranking: ROC-AUC and PR-AUC from the raw logit in the fake-positive direction, on successful rows. Ranking is not the operational decision and is not a threshold search.
metrics.review: Counts, rate, coverage, and selective accuracy are reported separately. DINOv2 must produce zero REVIEW rows.
metrics.agreement: Count of identical native decisions and of disagreements among paired successful rows. No image paths in the committed aggregate.
metrics.per_brand: Descriptive counts wherever a brand has at least one successful row. No cross-brand generalization claim.
metrics.latency: Wall time of each Triton request divided by the number of images in that request. p50 and p95 are percentiles of those per-image times. Throughput is successful images divided by the sum of Triton request wall times.
metrics.gpu_memory: nvidia-smi memory.used sampled before the sweep, every 512 images, and at the end. The reported value is the maximum sample, in MiB.

parity_gate.when: After identity checks and before the sweep.
parity_gate.dinov2_reference: CPU FP32 DINOv2Classifier strict-loaded from best_model.pt, same preprocess_chw tensors sent to Triton.
parity_gate.dinov3_reference: CPU FP32 reference_inference.load_reference_model and forward_logits, same resize_pad_square_eval_v1 tensors sent to Triton.
parity_gate.serving: Existing GPU Triton at localhost:18001. Batch sizes stay 8 and 16. No substitute model.
parity_gate.on_failure: Stop. Do not start the sweep and do not widen the tolerance.

stop_conditions: Either checkpoint, config, manifest, temperature file, or serving-config hash differs from this protocol.
The recomputed primary cohort is not 315 authentic-labeled A. Lange & Söhne images and 0 fake-labeled images.
The watch corpus is not 30000 images or the locked test exclusion is not 3006.
A blocked final-test or OOD path is opened.
Parity max absolute logit error exceeds 1e-4 for either model.
Triton is not serving both models on KIND_GPU with the pinned batch sizes available.
DINOv2 emits REVIEW, or either model emits a decision outside its policy.
A sweep image lacks exactly one result for each model.
Duplicate sample ids appear in the corpus.
